svg.aria-label: Root locus of K over s times s plus 1 times s plus 5. Branches start at the poles 0, minus 1 and minus 5. The branches from 0 and minus 1 meet and break away at about minus 0.47, then follow the plus and minus 60 degree asymptotes from the centroid minus 2, crossing the imaginary axis at plus or minus j 2.24 when K = 30. The third branch runs from minus 5 to minus infinity.
